thread:
Ana (AE): Quick sync — Kestrel Health POC. They want to run a finetuned Llama-3-13B-FT variant with int8 quant on Dedicated. Main asks: KV-cache compatibility, p99 latency targets at 512-token context, rough per-token pricing under a commit, and support for customer-managed KMS + VPC. Also security questionnaire (SOC2 + data residency). Can we triage?

Max (SRE): For int8 we need the quantized artifact or a conversion step. If not available, we'll fall back to float16 which increases memory and latency. KV cache works if the model uses standard causal attention state shapes — I need to see the model ops.

Sam (ML Eng): Quick bench from similar 13B int8 on our infra: ~75ms p50, ~220ms p99 for 512 tokens with batching=1 and warmed KV cache. Float16 is closer to 140ms/420ms. Note: some int8 toolchains change attention permutes and can break optimized kernels.

Elliot (Solutions Eng): Customer expected ~120ms p99 for interactive demo. Recommend two paths: (A) convert + quant-aware finetune to stabilize int8 (preferred), (B) serve float16 on reserved capacity (predictable but costlier). Pricing delta usually ~20-30% depending on token mix.

Nora (Security): We can support customer KMS + VPC and SOC2 controls. For data residency, we need region pinning (which region?). Also confirm whether any PHI will be processed in the POC — BAAs may be required.

Ana (AE): They're in eu-west-1. Demo will ingest deidentified medical notes initially, but customer expects BAA later. Timeline requested: how quickly can we finish the questionnaire and turn on KMS?

Max (SRE): KMS onboarding typically 3-5 business days once keys are shared. Security questionnaire initial review 48-72 hours. Compatibility scan for the model (ops + kv shapes) — Sam and I can run that in ~2 business days.

Sam (ML Eng): I'll run a variant-compat scan tonight: checking attention op names, layernorm placement, and kv cache tensor shapes. If ops mismatch we can either shim or ask for a rebuilt artifact. I'll post logs here.

Elliot (Solutions Eng): For pricing, what's their expected sustained QPS for the POC? Also, are they expecting SLA guarantees or just performance targets for demo?

Ana (AE): Target is avg 10 QPS, peak 25 QPS during 30-minute demos. No SLA for POC, but they want to understand Dedicated commit costs and what latencies look like under commit.

Sam (ML Eng): First-pass results: model uses a flash_attention_v2 op alias which maps to our optimized kernel (good). One minor warning: custom rotary embedding shift that could affect KV alignment. Example detected: 
```python
# detected pattern
attn = FlashAttn(..., rotary_shift=7)
```
We can shim to normalize shift but it requires a small runtime patch (low risk).

Max (SRE): If a shim is needed we'll route traffic to a canary pool. Cost estimate rough calc: 10 QPS sustained with 512 tokens average -> ~13B tokens/month. With int8 on committed capacity that's roughly in the low thousands USD/month range (ballpark $5k–$8k depending on exact commit and caching effects). Elliot, please replace with exact pricing calc.

Elliot (Solutions Eng): Will do. I'll prepare a 1-pager with two SKUs (POC commit vs on-demand burst), plus a fallback plan to a 7B variant if latency can't meet their demo needs. Also include cost delta with/without quantization.

Ana (AE): Action items: Sam + Max run full compatibility scan and post artifacts (logs + any shim patches) by EOD +2 (two business days). Nora to confirm questionnaire timeline and BAA requirements. Elliot to send pricing + ops one-pager. I'll communicate timelines to the customer and schedule a tech review.

Nora (Security): Confirmed — I can do initial questionnaire review by Wed EOD. KMS onboarding ETA Fri next week if keys are exchanged. Legal sign-off required for BAA — add Legal (Maya) when ready.

deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: reserving canary pool 'kestrel-poc-canary' tomorrow 09:00 UTC.

Ana (AE): Perfect — thanks all. I'll DM customer contact (dr_singh@kestrelhealth) and loop in Legal. :thumbsup:
